Method.name: GetNcidsForRepresentation
Method.Implementation:
#dim reqObj As ITFCOMMON.HDD.Object $$$LOGINFO("GetNcidsForRepresentation " _ pRequest.listOfHddNcidObj.Count())
set listInd = pRequest.listOfHddNcidObj.Next("") set list = ##class(%ListOfObjects).%New()
while ( listInd '= "") { set ncid = "" set reqObj = pRequest.listOfHddNcidObj.GetAt(listInd) Do ..GetHddNcidForRep(reqObj.Rep, reqObj.Domain, reqObj.Context, .ncid)
set hddObj = ##class(ITFCOMMON.HDD.Object).%New() set hddObj.Comment = "Test Comment" set hddObj.NCID = ncid set hddObj.Context = reqObj.Context set hddObj.Domain = reqObj.Domain set hddObj.Rep = reqObj.Rep set hddObj.Index = reqObj.Index
Do list.Insert(hddObj) set listInd = pRequest.listOfHddNcidObj.Next(listInd) } set pResponse = ##class(ITFCOMMON.HDD.LookupResponse).%New() set pResponse.listOfHDDobj = list
$$$LOGINFO("Return Count: " _ pResponse.listOfHDDobj.Count() _ ", NCID: " _ pResponse.listOfHDDobj.GetNext("").NCID) Quit $$$OK

#dim reqObj As ITFCOMMON.HDD.Object $$$LOGINFO("GetRepresentationForNcids " _ pRequest.listOfHddRepObj.Count())
set listInd = pRequest.listOfHddRepObj.Next("") set list = ##class(%ListOfObjects).%New() set ncid = "" while ( listInd '= "") { set rep = "" set reqObj = pRequest.listOfHddRepObj.GetAt(listInd) Do ..GetHddRepForNcid(reqObj.NCID, reqObj.Context, .rep)
set hddObj = ##class(ITFCOMMON.HDD.Object).%New() set hddObj.Comment = "Test Comment" set hddObj.NCID = reqObj.NCID set hddObj.Context = reqObj.Context set hddObj.Domain = "" set hddObj.Rep = rep set hddObj.Index = reqObj.Index
Do list.Insert(hddObj) set listInd = pRequest.listOfHddRepObj.Next(listInd) } set pResponse = ##class(ITFCOMMON.HDD.LookupResponse).%New() set pResponse.listOfHDDobj = list
$$$LOGINFO("Return Count: " _ pResponse.listOfHDDobj.Count() _ ", rep: " _ pResponse.listOfHDDobj.GetNext("").Rep) Quit $$$OK
